remarks:
Rare opportunity to purchase a 2-unit property situated on 6.5 acres, complete with an attached garage and two massive outbuildings. This 2/1 and 1/1 residence offers excellent potential for rental income, guest accommodations, multi-generational living, or caretaker housing.
The expansive outbuildings provide endless possibilities for equipment storage, workshops, hobby farming, business use, or recreational vehicle storage. With abundant space and flexibility, this property serves as the perfect complement to the adjacent single-family residence (see MLS #B1685161), which is also being offered for sale. Seller requesting to sell as a package , will not divide. Together, these properties create a unique opportunity for a family compound, investment portfolio, or private country estate. Seller is open to possible owner financing.
